title.value: CAS-ANSO Scholarship 2027 (Master's and PhD at UCAS)
title.evidence_quote: CAS-ANSO Scholarship 2027 Call for Applications to Study at UCAS

institution.name: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS)

field: Science and technology (master's and doctoral programmes)
qualifications: Non-Chinese citizen with a valid passport
Master's applicants born after 1 January 1997; PhD applicants born after 1 January 1992
High level of English proficiency (HSK 5, 180+, for Chinese-taught programmes)
description_short: The CAS-ANSO Scholarship 2027 supports non-Chinese citizens applying for master's or PhD study at the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences. Applications opened on 17 November 2026; the deadline for applicants and referees is 28 February 2027 (Beijing time).

deadline.evidence_quote: Deadline for applicants and referees: 28th February 2027 (Beijing Time)

status_evidence: Official UCAS call (seen in search results): 'The 2027 CAS-ANSO Scholarship is open for application on 17th November 2026.'
